meta.corpus: toy 81k Common Crawl (CC-MAIN-2026-34, unranked slice), top_coarse=50, nprobe=8, max_pair_tokens=64, batch=32
meta.rubric: A result is RELEVANT (1) if the page's main subject is the subject the query names — i.e. a user issuing this query would find the page on-topic for it. Same-domain pages count (e.g. any Windows/Microsoft-version or Windows-update page for a Windows query; any legal-service or legal-procedure page for a 'lawyer in <city>' query; any woodworking tool/material page for a woodworking query). Unrelated, off-language-but-off-topic, spam, portal index and garbage-binary pages are 0. The query text is a URL slug, so 'the subject the query names' is read from the slug.
known_limits: n=10 queries, 20 judgements each (100 per system) - a 1-2 result difference is noise.
LLM judge, not human; no inter-annotator agreement measured.
Topic-level relevance, not answer-level: a page can be on-topic without containing the specific answer.
meta.bits_order: per query, the 20 characters are in review.jsonl file order (the shuffled A/B presentation order); 'A' slots are the coarse ANN top-10, 'B' slots the MiniLM-L6 reranked top-10.
